provenance.robot: UR5e + reviewed BDS mock-pruner, six actuated UR joints
provenance.controller: Causal pyramidal-LK RGB-D visual servo, bounded Cartesian IK; seed pixel supplied once
provenance.robot_state: measured PhysX articulation state, not teleported joint replay
provenance.wrist_rgb: RTX rgb annotator; exterior tool-mounted camera with fixed simulation-defined toe-in; not hardware calibration
provenance.close_rgb: RTX rgb annotator; static external close-up camera
provenance.depth: RTX distance_to_image_plane; simulator ground truth, not learned depth
provenance.tof: two live MultiMeshRayCasterCamera 8x8 15Hz at reviewed sensor offsets; noise disabled
provenance.environment: Original Blender orchard USD meshes, UVs and image maps; see scene provenance
provenance.cutting: Visual jaw surrogate and gated rigid-piece detachment; no wood fracture or actuated blade CAD
provenance.contact: PhysX measured forces; coverage recorded explicitly
provenance.recognition: Branch identity, axis and radius supplied by selected mesh metadata; not learned recognition

lab3_compat: isaaclab.utils.math: unwrap ProxyArray on 32 scripted fns

capture_quality.evidence_scope: Carb setting readback only; not measured sample count or visual quality

limitations: Jaw meshes are a visual surrogate at tool-local +Z 0.070 m, not actuated pruner CAD.
Detachment switches an existing 5 g rigid piece from kinematic to dynamic; no wood fracture is modeled.
Target identity and initialization use known Blender mesh topology, not a learned classifier.
Original terrain relief is visual only; the caller's flat plane remains the ground collider.
The original Blender procedural sky is not reproduced by this USD export.

presentation_overrides.reason: Meter-scale ground detail and visible RTX sunlight; not Blender lighting parity

blender_scene.sky_fill: Constant blue-white dome at intensity 450; not original procedural sky
blender_scene.piece_pose_source: PhysX rigid-body tensor view, world xyz + wxyz

camera.wrist_mount: simulation-defined exterior mount; fixed optical toe-in initialized using the known fixture target
camera.wrist_optical_convention: +Z forward, +X right, +Y down (ROS); fixed rotation relative to tool recorded above

capture_quality_after_warmup.evidence_scope: Carb setting readback only; not measured sample count or visual quality

vision_initialization.source: Known selected component projected once; no per-frame oracle update or automatic reseeding

initial_live_vision.target_identity_axis_radius_source: Selected Blender branch metadata; not learned recognition
initial_live_vision.depth_source: Live RTX optical-Z ground truth, not learned depth
initial_live_vision.cut_model: Visual jaw surrogate and discrete detachment; not material fracture

metrics.return_reference: Measured initial home before the first vision command

final_live_vision.target_identity_axis_radius_source: Selected Blender branch metadata; not learned recognition
final_live_vision.depth_source: Live RTX optical-Z ground truth, not learned depth
final_live_vision.cut_model: Visual jaw surrogate and discrete detachment; not material fracture
